title: Module locks are mutually exclusive
statement: At most one task MUST hold a lock on a given (substrate, module) tuple at any time. Two concurrent devai work lock acquire invocations for the same target MUST produce exactly one acquired and one denied result.
rationale: Article 25 makes module-level mutex the substrate of safe parallel work. The file-lock implementation must use atomic create (O_CREAT|O_EXCL) and fsync; a TOCTOU race between existsSync and writeFile is a correctness bug, not a performance bug.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
